setup.default:
ROOT="$(cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/.." && pwd)" || exit 1
. "${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}/nvm.sh" || exit 1
nvm install || exit 1
nvm use || exit 1
[ "$(node -v)" = "$(nvm version "$(cat .nvmrc)")" ] || { echo "Node $(node -v) does not match .nvmrc $(cat .nvmrc)" >&2; false; } || exit 1
for f in "$ROOT"/.env*; do n="${f##*/}"; [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -e "$n" ] && git check-ignore -q "$n" && cp "$f" "$n"; done; true || exit 1
sh scripts/configure-git-hooks.sh || exit 1
npx --yes npm@10.9.4 ci || exit 1
uv sync --frozen || exit 1
